fullContentHtml:
Chhattisgarh State Eligibility Test SET Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board (CG Vyapam) has released the admit card for the Chhattisgarh State Eligibility Test (CG SET) 2026. Applications for the Chhattisgarh SET Online Form 2026 were accepted from 23 July 2026 to 17 August 2026. The written examination is scheduled for 04 October 2026. Candidates who applied can download their Chhattisgarh State Eligibility Test SET Admit Card 2026 from the verified official links below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 23 July 2026
  • Last Date : 17 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 17 August 2026
  • Correction Date : 18-20 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 04 October 2026
  • Admit Card : 28 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General / Other State : Rs. 300/-
  • OBC Candidates : Rs. 250/-
  • SC, ST and PwBD Candidates : Rs. 200/-

How to Download Chhattisgarh SET Admit Card

  1. Visit the official CG Vyapam portal or click the direct Admit Card link below.
  2. Login with your Registered Mobile Number and Password.
  3. Navigate to the Admit Card section and select CG SET 2026.
  4. Download the hall ticket PDF and print a clear copy to carry to the exam center.

Important Links

  • Download Admit Card
  • Download Revised Notice
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Chhattisgarh State Eligibility Test SET Admit Card 2026?

Chhattisgarh State Eligibility Test SET Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket issued by CG Vyapam for candidates appearing in the State Eligibility Test for Assistant Professor recruitment.

Where can I find the official direct link?

The official direct link is available on the CG Vyapam portal at vyapamprofile.cgstate.gov.in and listed in the Important Links table above.
